broader_control_union_rule: Original155 cache/212 requirement/24 native/100 native-reference obligations are preserved in their original activities. This definition does not move all212 S05.03 or F4/M source bodies into S03.08 absent an actual named source dependency.

categories.includes: Pristine Root startup, initial TCB authentication, early cold authority capture, queue admission, all process/group/child tracking and aggregate outer measurement; charge before driver START_WALL and after its final sample.

All original and new source/input inventory/hash/byte/mode checks, pinned closure copy, static packet assembly/inverses, retained source/proof copies, installation inventories and actual startup reads in each selected invocation.

Each of three original metadata cold builds plus all original backend/trace/native builds and child CPU/wall/IO/logs/journals/dependency/header reads. Failed builds and no-retry termination remain charged; no reused binary or zero-cost compiler fixture.

Current actual native/header/FFI/provider/loaded-image/stdlib/primitive profile, preflight, controls, source admission and every original direct/native/reference check. Source definition does not create observed receipts.

OriginalGraph, typed factory/source/function/class/default/closure/global/lookup snapshots, twelve actual product roles, native bind clone, AST parse/deepcopy/compile and strict whole-source/code inverses; all concurrent old/new source, AST, code, result and proof graphs.

Every genuine original circuit/Checks/fixture constructor including prearm P08 extra constructor, fallback, native, normalization, counters, source checks and bookkeeping; all fixture copies/temporaries/oracle preparation are charged without suppressed effects.

K committed records: dict index capacity, native id integer and fixed seven-field record tuple; at most one pending record; original store/constructor work and actual metadata capacities. Labels/basis/keys are original pointers but retained capacity and transient ownership still charged.

Q actual private role/label/residual requests, nonce and request dictionary, operand tuples, stage/view set, signatures, prepare/finish, literal key/member/store, exact identity comparisons, current source+native checks and original authority state. Do not infer Q from complement or Gram counts.

All unsupported mapping/hook/public escape/reentry/capacity/lifetime fallbacks: retirement, original Owner._data, public V8 canonicalization/collision/counters and full continuation. Charge private attempt plus fallback; no silent truncated case or fast-pass credit.

All original arithmetic kernels, independent Fraction work, ordered rank/complement trace, full map/labels/roles/integer-bound/upstream verification and exact type/order witness collection. Baseline and candidate both retain complete obligations.

Every required original cache helper body with each distinct genuine context/source image/mode/lifecycle and all existing control unions in their original activities. Include source fault image preparation, fresh owner/bootstrap, construction, execution, oracles and cleanup for each invocation; body count is not funded command count.

Every P/A/S/R/J and absent-record P/R1/J1/R2/J2 channel allocation, transfer, ACK and consumed-replay check, fixed records/dicts and append-only lists. Retain exact raw errors, causes and traceback/Label/Checks/native/source graph frames until proper parent disposal; finite pointer count does not bound retained graph bytes.

Original lossless typed serialization, full stdout/certificate/side/complement outputs, witnesses, comparisons, source and result hashing, receipt writes, fs metadata/IO and diagnostics. Do not substitute a digest for the original observations or omit failed-attempt evidence.

All normal/error disarm, retirement, metadata close, native owner disposal, source/stdlib/current checks, before-late and late-last, STOP evidence, final custody checks and process teardown. Include both failed cleanup attempts and secondary retention; no forbidden post-late native check.

Complete parent scheduling/monitoring/accounting, log/receipt/custody readback and retained FD/image/page/allocator/GC/RSS tail through last child/process exit. Charge all retries only if separately authorized; failed or rejected runs are not subtracted.

full_invoice.cpu: CPU_total is actual parent/driver and all compiler/control/helper child process CPU, including failed setup/cleanup and receipt tails, with each process lifetime counted once.
full_invoice.index: For every separately selected actual invocation j and every unique exclusive work segment e, assign exactly one C01-C15 owner. Assign shared setup to the actual common parent or to each actual fresh invocation as incurred; never omit or fabricate amortization.
full_invoice.peak: RSS_peak is actual aggregate concurrent high-water across parent/driver/children plus separately declared retained FD/image/page and allocator profile; a sum of individual maxima is not an observed aggregate peak.
full_invoice.setup_baseline: Both original complete arms pay the complete actual common control union, Root/native/source setup and teardown. Any asymmetry must be explicit and reviewed; no free candidate-only qualification or baseline control elision.
full_invoice.unmeasured: Every unevaluated time/CPU/byte value remains null/unknown. No unknown is treated as zero, no projected gain admitted and no price proof is inferred from symbolic completeness.
full_invoice.wall: W_total is actual outer admission-to-final-teardown elapsed time. Per-phase nested samples are diagnostic and must not be summed as if exclusive. Exclusive segment partition plus idle/wait/parent tails must reconcile to W_total.

K.condition: Pinned exact original complete source and eligible closed lifetime; mismatch/capacity retires private metadata and continues original V8. Not an observed K.

source_quantities.Q: Every actual original verify_labels and forward/reverse role-label/residual request, counted from actual loops and complete coverage; currently not measured.
source_quantities.metadata_byte_formula: M_fixed + DictIndexCapacity(K) + K*(NativeIdInteger64 + Tuple7) + Pending1 + PeakConcurrentSourceCompilationCaptureTemporaries + ErrorRetainedGraphs + ActualAllocatorOverhead
source_quantities.original_retained_graph: Original Label/basis/key objects are not duplicated by a record; their pre-existing and error-extended ownership and actual allocator footprint still enter aggregate RSS. No claim of zero extra error memory.
